end.summary:
Observed and described plant and animal features.
Identified a leaf’s pointed tip and central line.
Explained that a beak is used for eating and is a bird feature.
Attempted descriptions of beak and feet; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Atharv practised noticing and describing leaf and bird features, using prompts about the part being observed and its purpose. They correctly identified a pointed leaf tip, the middle line of a leaf, and the beak as a bird feature used for eating. Descriptions of the beak and feet remained incomplete; no clear misconception was recorded or corrected later. At home, show one leaf or bird picture and ask Atharv to name its shape, one feature, and what that feature does.
